body.opens: An expression says the grain at which it looks upon things, over commits as over the field: squashing a section squashes its commits, giving a surface smaller and quicker to index and read, while the deeper is kept detachably; one querying a store into one's own chooses the depth and holds what it took whole even if the other is wiped, and the interface shows the depths available, to load on demand.
restsOn: A link into a grain not held reads as deeper, not here, never as dead.

body.opens: Whether a brief draws as its face or in full: by an offer, by where it stands, or as grain, the face being the brief at a coarser grain, a zoom rather than a type as one panelist held.
Draw, which realization of a component a surface uses, waits for a second surface; reach, what a use may read and commit, waits for boundaries.
restsOn: A component declared once and realized per surface.

name: Draw and reach on a use

body.opens: Briefs and prompts with holes, parametric types such as a list of briefs, programs configured and ready to start, synth presets: each type opening holes by its mould when a real case asks.
restsOn: A type opening holes by its mould.

body.opens: What a use gives is derived, so neither cited nor indexed; a program may commit it as a stamp, which must be named apart from the live result.
A change dropping or retyping an input that uses still fill is judged, showing those uses, rather than passing silently.
restsOn: Judging a use's args against its function's input.

name: Judging a change to a function's input

body.opens: Whether a reference may name a commit of what it points at, pinned, or follows the holon as it moves, live, and whether these are kinds of reference or ways of reading one; for every reference, not only uses.
restsOn: Every commit keeping what its maker had read.

body.opens: Whether the act of matching, which component was found for what, by whom and when, is kept as a holon of its own, beside the pick written into the use.
restsOn: A component picked once and written into the use.

body.opens: What a sovereign store owes the whole it belongs to: governance between stores, merging, and where local truths disagree; put aside for another day.
Whether every name, briefs included, is lowercase and dashed, as the author leaned for components and addresses.
Whether the settled rule that code names what it needs by address, never by id, should be reopened, since a rename or move changes what a use means in silence.
Functions at the bottom native to the engine, or given as one's own code in whatever runtime is made available.
restsOn: What the engine may ask of a runtime.

body.opens: How functions, components and uses are written as text for people to read, a spelling over the honest HCL read into holons and printed back exactly: not Lisp, which people find hard to read; the pipe one-liner kept for queries in the bar.
Whether layout as data holds, tested by building the search bar's pills as data: each, function pairs, items knowing their place, and code at the leaves; if any fails, layout as data is not ready.

name: Layout as data proven by search

body.kept: Whole in the author's words: every utterance as it came, typed or spoken as it reads; two sent twice, a shorter form and then a fuller, one resent on resuming the session and one after its context was compacted, are kept once, in the fuller form. The session's answers by their essence, short; its panels' reports are kept only as woven into the answers that weighed them.

name: An eighteenth session: the new engine held to the earlier one over every store, six faults mended, and functions and components applied alike, by a use held where it is consumed
